aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor grouping, pair matching, and numeric outcomes are not reliable.

Rebuild VP separate outcome using only rows with valid matched normal baseline; treat later test-only rows as trend data, not comparisons.
Correct input, NG, OK, VP separate, and rate values from each cited row.
Remove bogus measurement outcomes and keep only defect-rate outcomes with row citations.
